verdict.rationale: Apple's M4 launch materials say developers can work with LLMs of nearly 200 billion parameters, which covers 70B-class quantized models. Apple also publishes 546GB/s of unified memory bandwidth for the 40-core GPU M4 Max ("over half a terabyte per second" in Mac Studio materials). Apple's MLX framework uses that unified memory model, giving a first-party path for local inference. Missing for 10: an explicit maximum unified memory figure for M4 Max in the evidence, and independent or hands-on 70B inference benchmarks (tokens/s) confirming the setup is practical.
